name: Arp de Levy
description: Lévy-flight generative arpeggiator — evolve, texture, and expression

sections.heading: Mutation, texture, flight
items: Persistent note pool walked with Lévy-flight steps — mostly small moves, occasional leaps
CV (1V/oct, quantized unless Bypass quantizer) and MIDI fire together on each hit
Mutation rate freezes the pool at the bottom; more Lévy edits at each phrase boundary as you raise it
Texture jointly moves density (rests), phrase length (16 down to 4 steps), and swing
Button + Fader sets Lévy α (local ↔ wild jump character)

sections.heading: Gestures
items: Short press — Reroll pool + expression depth; reset phrase
Shift + short — Reverse playback (CV Out: cycle Pitch / Gate / Velocity)

sections.heading: Expression & LEDs
items: Short press (and CV Dest = Reroll) re-rolls the pool and picks a new expression depth for velocity and gate jitter
Top LED — phrase progress (app color); orange for texture; violet for Lévy α
Button LED — octave color; white↔off on reverse; off when muted
Scenes store the live note pool, phrase length, and expression depth

channels.jackDescription: Jack mode selects Pitch CV out or CV in (Evolve / Texture / Reroll). MIDI note fires in parallel unless muted.
channels.faderDescription: How strongly the note pool Lévy-walks at each phrase boundary. Bottom = frozen loop.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: One macro for density (rests), phrase length (from 16 steps down to 4), and swing.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Flight character — low = local steps, high = wild jumps.
channels.fnDescription: Short press: new note pool, new expression depth (vel/gate jitter), restart phrase. Long press: mute.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Short: reverse playback. Long: cycle octave span 1–4.
